title: How Dossierly works
lead: One private agent per person, with you before, during and after every visit.
prepareBody: Before an appointment, your agent reads today's official pages and builds a checklist where every line cites its paragraph.
meetBody: At the counter, lay the phone flat. Each side reads in their own language, and a watcher flags dates, amounts and documents.
wrapBody: After the visit: what was agreed, what to bring and which dates were named, filed into your case.
lettersBody: Photograph a letter or upload the PDF. You see the Polish beside the explanation, the link to earlier visits and the deadline, counted step by step.
agentBody: Every person gets a private agent that works on a masked copy of the case, running on Claude by Anthropic.
guardTitle: It interprets and explains. It never advises.
guardBody: Every turn passes a guard that refuses legal or medical advice.
guardLawyer: For advice about your case, find a lawyer in the Polish bar register, rejestradwokatow.pl.
a1: In your own private case file on Cloudflare, one per account, readable only when you are signed in. It is never sold. Names and case numbers are masked before any model call.
q2: Can I open my case on another device?
a2: Yes. Sign in with a code sent to your email and your case opens on any device. Only your chat history stays in the browser where you had it.
a3: Write to gabriel@larinova.com from the email you sign in with. We delete your case file and your account.
a4: gabriel@larinova.com. Dossierly is operated by Larinova Private Limited.
